<!--
Thanks for contributing to Mova Store. Keep pull requests scoped to a single
issue where possible, and reference it in the description.

Title convention: conventional-commit style with a lowercase scope, e.g.
  fix(sidebar): fix undefined modal references
  test(stellar): cover readOrder with a mocked RPC
-->

## What does this change?

<!-- A short summary, and the issue it resolves. e.g. Closes #123 -->

## Why?

<!-- The problem this solves. Link the issue. -->

## How was it tested?

<!-- Commands you ran and what you observed. -->

- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run type-check`
- [ ] `npm run test`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `cargo test` in `contracts/checkout` (if the contract changed)

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is scoped to the linked issue
- [ ] No secrets, keys or `.env` values are included
- [ ] New behaviour is covered by tests
- [ ] Documentation was updated where behaviour changed
